scope: Native UI Inspect/Compare, instrument replacement, empty/generated layer authoring, review/cancel/audition/apply, undo/reopen; not hardware or full musical-quality qualification
steps: Generated new role is nonempty, scoped, previewable, cancellable and undoable
Instrument choice auditions real audio and replaces only the instrument after approval
Selected later phrase previews only its clip; stale proposals cannot overwrite intervening edits
Inspect and editor share the chosen layer/clip/note; empty clips become real editable notes
Phone/landscape inspector controls remain reachable and authoring survives native reopen
